title: Effect of Morning Versus Evening Perindopril on Blood Pressure Control in People With Type 2 Diabetes
brief_summary: We assessed the influence of time of administration of ACE inhibitors on circadian blood pressure control in sub Saharan type 2 diabetes patients with stage 1 hypertension over 56 days as first line treatment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Type 2 diabetes
* Grade 1 hypertension
* Informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* estimated creatinine clearance≤ 60ml/min
* White coat hypertension after initial 24 hour ABPM
* Previous antihypertensive treatment
* Pregnant women
* Individuals working during the night
* Hyperkalemia
